Joe Dooley, now 49 and going as strong as ever, led home a six strong Belgrave contingent at Harlow's "Unigate" Marathon on October 28th. Joe was 120th of the 260 finishers in 2 hours 52 minutes 48 seconds.

Lionel Mann started well, but fell away with a recurrence of the leg injury which has been giving him trouble during the past year. Joe Dooley ran strongly to win the over 50's prize. 1.K.Penny (Cam) 49.55; 2.P.Richardson (Havering) 50.39; 3.B.Watson (Cam) 50.42.

Moving on over 300 places to 694th we find Veteran (over 50) Joe Dooley cracking three hours with 2:52.48 in the Unigate. Closely following is John Davies (veteran 40+) 744th in 2:54.55 (Goldenlay/Poly).

Bels 0/50's (Charlie Walker, Charlie Henn and Joe Dooley) withstood Waverley's challenge to take first place.
